data.prompt: A sleek smartphone stand with a light gray-green base and support rod, paired with a dark gray phone silhouette in dynamic tilt—set on a sunlit wooden desk in a modern European apartment. Soft natural light streams from a large window, casting gentle shadows. Composed using rule of thirds, captured at a 45-degree angle with an 85mm lens at f/1.8 for shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh. High-detail commercial photography style: clean, minimalist, lifestyle-oriented. Visible colors: muted sage green, charcoal gray, warm oak tones. Smooth geometric shapes—low-profile trapezoidal base, slender curved rod, angled rectangular phone outline. No text, logos, watermarks, or faces.
